title: HB1291 (2021 Regular): Public Safety - Untraceable Firearms

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2021RS/bills/hb/hb1291f.pdf)
provenance.note: first_reader: bill as filed; no vote recorded. Section 5-703(a)(2) (possess, sell, transfer, buy such items) is also in the bill but omitted from the quote for length.

operative_text:
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-101(h)): (1) “Firearm” means: (i) a weapon that expels, is designed to expel, or may readily be converted to expel a projectile by the action of an explosive; or (ii) the UNFINISHED frame or receiver, AS DEFINED IN § 5–701 OF THIS TITLE, of such a weapon.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-701(g)): (1) “UNFINISHED FRAME OR RECEIVER” MEANS A FRAME OR RECEIVER OF A FIREARM WHOSE FIRE–CONTROL CAVITY IS COMPLETELY SOLID AND UN–MACHINED, AND WHICH MAY BE READILY MADE INTO A FUNCTIONAL FRAME OR RECEIVER OF A FIREARM THROUGH MILLING, DRILLING, FILING, MOLDING, OR OTHER MEANS.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-702): THIS SUBTITLE DOES NOT APPLY TO: (1) A FIREARM THAT: (I) WAS MANUFACTURED BEFORE 1968; (II) HAS BEEN RENDERED PERMANENTLY INOPERABLE; OR (III) IS BEING TRANSFERRED OR SURRENDERED TO A LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCY; OR (2) SALES, OFFERS TO SELL, TRANSFERS, DELIVERY, OR POSSESSION OF ANY FIREARM OR UNFINISHED FRAME OR RECEIVER BETWEEN: (I) FEDERALLY LICENSED FIREARMS MANUFACTURERS; (II) FEDERALLY LICENSED FIREARMS IMPORTERS; OR (III) FEDERALLY LICENSED FIREARMS DEALERS.
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-703(a)): A PERSON MAY NOT: (1) MANUFACTURE OR ASSEMBLE A FIREARM OR AN UNFINISHED FRAME OR RECEIVER THAT IS NOT IMPRINTED WITH A SERIAL NUMBER ISSUED BY A FEDERALLY LICENSED FIREARMS MANUFACTURER OR FEDERALLY LICENSED FIREARMS IMPORTER IN COMPLIANCE WITH ALL FEDERAL LAWS AND REGULATIONS REGULATING THE MANUFACTURE AND IMPORT OF FIREARMS;
Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Public Safety § 5-703(b)): (1) A PERSON WHO VIOLATES THIS SECTION IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND ON CONVICTION IS SUBJECT TO IMPRISONMENT NOT EXCEEDING 2 YEARS OR A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $5,000 OR BOTH. (2) EACH VIOLATION OF THIS SECTION IS A SEPARATE CRIME.
